name: 00_design_history_file
html:
00 Design History File (index)

Project: Hemodynamic Decision Support: three deployment concepts for the Version 5 physics-informed model Method: Biomedical Engineering Design (Tranquillo, Goldberg & Allen, Elsevier 2023), referred to below as BMED Status: Concept selection complete; working software prototype of all three concepts verified on held-out data Selected concept: Concept A, the integrated deterioration alert, forecast and intervention-response monitor, with Concept C's review report folded in as its documentation module (see 04 Concept selection)

BMED Section 6.8 says to keep design decisions and their evidence in a Design History File (DHF), so that a reviewer can trace every requirement to its verification. This folder is that file. Each document matches one stage of the BMED design process:

#DocumentBMED chapterWhat it answers
01Problem and project statementCh. 3What clinical problem, for whom, and what counts as success?
02Needs and engineering specificationsCh. 4Measurable design inputs, ideal and marginal values, benchmarking
03Concept generationCh. 5How the 5 briefs became 3 concepts (divergence, then confluence)
04Concept selectionCh. 6Gate, decision matrix, DSM with rotated datums, House of Quality, sensitivity analysis, decision
05Prototype and architectureCh. 7, 10How the software prototype is built; SOUP; traceability to the frozen Version 5 model
06Usability and risk managementCh. 8Nielsen heuristic evaluation; FMEA / ISO 14971; hazard H-09
07Verification and validationCh. 9Test methods, results against every specification, what is still unvalidated
08Standards, regulatory and ethicsCh. 11–13IEC/ISO standards, FDA pathway, ethical constraints
09Slide deck outlineCh. 14Suggested slides, with the figure and numbers for each

Evidence files (all regenerated by scripts, never typed in by hand)

FileProduced byContent
evaluation/specifications.jsondesign teamThe 15 specifications (single source for doc 02 and the verifier)
evaluation/results/verification_summary.jsonevaluation/evaluate_concepts.pyAll measured results

evaluation/results/calibration.jsonevaluate_concepts.pyBias and sigma per regime and domain (validation splits only)
evaluation/results/ticks_*.csv, quality_gate*.csv, intervention_agreement.csvevaluate_concepts.pyRaw per-update test records
evaluation/results/static_checks.jsonevaluation/static_checks.pySPEC-12/13/14 (heuristics, export, prescriptive-language scan)
evaluation/results/concept_selection.jsonevaluation/concept_selection.pyScores, matrices, sensitivity, decision and rationale
evaluation/fmea.json, evaluation/heuristic_evaluation.jsondesign teamRisk analysis and heuristic evaluation
docs/figures/*.pngscripts/make_figures.py + UI screenshotsEvery figure in these documents

Reproduce everything with scripts/run_verification.sh (about 15 minutes on the lab GPU workstation).

Version control of the model

The app vendors the Version 5 source code unchanged (src/) and loads data/models/physics-informed_real_finetuned.pth. The checksum is verified at start-up, shown in the app header and stored in every result file: SHA-256 6fbec94f8b40570badaf491689e6f15d1451a243567dd53f1f3541c5bc3e31b4.
